workspace.name: EVD-0011 暫定Active Skill 80件・Monster職業別装備可能対応表

project_context.purpose: EVD-0009に登録された暫定Active Skill 80件について、Monster全7職Lv1～50の基礎Status式を用い、各SkillのStat Thresholdを満たして装備可能になるMonster職業と最低Lvを固定Evidenceとして保存する。
project_context.summary: 80 Skill × 7職 = 560組を全件照合。各Skillごとに装備可能Monster職業、最低装備可能Lv、最低Lv時点の必要Stat実値、Lv1～50内では装備不可のMonster職業を保持する。Battle/Simulationは実行しない。

current_focus.theme: EVD-0011 Monster Skill装備可能職業・最低Lv対応表
current_focus.goal: 後続のMonster Skill実戦Balance Testで、Skill Thresholdを実際に満たすMonsterだけを合法な測定主体として選別できるEvidenceを登録する。

source_baseline.source_role: Inherited Fresh Current baseline from EVD-0009

history.message: Created EVD-0011 by joining EVD-0009 provisional Skill stat thresholds against Monster 7-job Lv1-50 base Status using M_s(Level,Job)=Level*JobGrowth(Job,s)/10. No Source/Game Data modification and no Battle/Simulation execution.

authority_basis.job_growth_source: Same Human-approved 7-job JobGrowth values used by the Monster base Status authority and recorded in EVD-0001.
authority_basis.equipability_rule: For a Skill, a Monster job/level is equipable when every stat in skill.stat_thresholds is greater than or equal to the required threshold. The minimum qualifying level within Lv1..50 is recorded.
authority_basis.job_restriction_rule: No separate Job restriction is applied. Eligibility is determined only from EVD-0009 stat_thresholds and Monster base Status.
authority_basis.level_range_rule: Search only Lv1..50, matching EVD-0005 authority scope. If no qualifying level exists in this range, record as not equipable within Lv1..50.
authority_basis.evidence_boundary: This Evidence establishes Monster base-stat-threshold equipability only. It does not prove Formal Skill Master registration, runtime execution validity, Monster AI selection, enemy_budget_cost, combat balance, or actual Monster generation assignment.
authority_basis.human_review: Human instructed creation of a Monster-version job-by-job Skill equipability correspondence table in Evidence registration format.
